name: VPN Manager
author: fivefold3
description: VPN manager with support for WireGuard and OpenVPN via NetworkManager. Import and edit profiles. Multi-hop nesting, internet kill switch and auto-connect.

barWidget.description: Import WireGuard .conf and OpenVPN .ovpn profiles, connect and disconnect, nest them inside each other, and bring up a connection automatically.

schema.label: Status check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the icon checks VPN status while panel is closed.

schema.description: Import list shows WireGuard and OpenVPN files found here. Browse starts here.
